integrity: Complete proof, exact 24-state finite reduction, and independently implemented direct prefix checks in a stand-alone Python 3 file. All claimed infinity-level results rest on the recurrence and complete state coverage, not numerical extrapolation.
scientific_limitations: The theorem covers dyadic lengths at least sixteen of the regular paperfolding word, not arbitrary lengths or generalized paperfolding. Its exhaustive finite map is supplemented by an exact infinite-position state recurrence; direct checks alone are not infinite proofs. No exhaustive guarantee against unindexed equivalent publications is claimed.
title: Dyadic \(3\)-Abelian stability and uniform refinement in the regular paperfolding word
